sloka: तान् पूजयित्वा धर्मात्मा राजा दशरथः तदा ।इदम् धर्म अर्थ सहितम् श्लक्ष्णम् वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-८-७॥
transliteration: tān pūjayitvā dharmātmā rājā daśarathaḥ tadā ।idam dharma artha sahitam ślakṣṇam vacanam abravīt ॥1-8-7॥

translations.english: Virtuous king Dasaratha paid homage to them (the ministers) and uttered these gracious, righteous and meaningful words.
